channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 14 Sep: Harare clear sky · high 26° / low 14°
item.description: Harare: high 26°, low 14° (clear sky) · Bulawayo: high 30°, low 15° (mainly clear) · Mutare: high 25°, low 13° (partly cloudy) · Gweru: high 28°, low 15° (mainly clear) · Masvingo: high 30°, low 16° (mainly clear) · Victoria Falls: high 35°, low 20° (overcast) Tsumo yezuva: Aive madziva ava mazambuko.
